description: Publish a site: put its pages' draft content live, write the snapshot the website's build reads, and (in hook mode) ping the deploy hook so the host rebuilds. This changes the public website. Omit `pages` to publish every page with unpublished changes, or pass specific page keys. `note` is an optional short publish note. Read the returned `status` (published, deploy_requested, deploy_failed, no_hook, feed) then check deploy_status for the live result.

note.description: Optional short note recorded with the publish.

pages.description: Page keys to publish; omit to publish all pages with changes.

name: publish
title: Publish to the live website
